N_formula: N = original shared replay median + max(original adapter-estimate median, R_adapter median) + 0

adapter_skeleton.conservatism: full _Node construction is timed although R0 constructs the same nodes (only the stored reference differs): an upper bound on the additional work
adapter_skeleton.inputs: the frozen M0 workload of each diagnostic program; BS1 states produced by an UNTIMED shared replay in the same process (no search is run, BS1 is not changed)

timed_operations_per_event.A child: read node.A.A[name]; read AS2.A; construct es._Node; push
timed_operations_per_event.A root: read AS.A; construct es._Node holding node.D and AS; push
timed_operations_per_event.P: read node state (and AS.A when in the address phase) through the adapter method
timed_operations_per_event.T child: read parent node's state reference and state.D (node.D.D[op]); construct es._Node holding the child TimeState; push
timed_operations_per_event.T root: construct es._Node holding the TimeState (slot write), push to the query frontier
timed_operations_per_event.dispatch: every event goes through one bound method of an adapter object (the C1 call-site indirection)
timed_operations_per_event.release: a node is released when the DFS expansion of its parent node ends (streaming: the first event that expands a different parent), unexpanded nodes at query (Propagation) end = epoch disposal; no future last-use knowledge is used

already_in_timed_shared_replay: state object creation and release after last use
replay-only bookkeeping (dict of outputs, release lists) which C1 does not do: kept in N as a conservative surplus

candidate_integration.C1: research/third_round_candidate.py = R0 (research/efficiency_search.py) with ONLY Expander changed: the node's D slot holds a BS1 TimeState, the A slot an AddressState; propagation calls go to third_round_kernel.SharedPropagation (class bodies unchanged, sha 77c373e1...).

call_site_diff_vs_R0.note: mask construction included in replay (per Propagation)

call_site_diff_vs_R0.in_timed_shared_replay: time_root, prune_state yes; node slot write: adapter

call_site_diff_vs_R0.C1: allowed=set(node.D.D[op]); S2=time_child(node.D, op, v); prune_state(S2,..); _Node(nxt, S2, ...)
call_site_diff_vs_R0.R0: allowed=set(node.D[op]); D2=dict(node.D); D2[op]=(v,); times_fixpoint(D2); prune(D2,..); _Node(nxt, D2, ...)
call_site_diff_vs_R0.additional: one attribute read (node.D.D) per expansion, a state-reference slot write per yielded child, the reference read node.D passed to time_child

call_site_diff_vs_R0.C1: AS=address_root(A, pairs); prune_state(node.D, AS.A, ..); _Node(state, node.D, AS, pairs, ...)
call_site_diff_vs_R0.R0: addresses_fixpoint(A, pairs); prune(node.D, A, ..); _Node(state, node.D, A, pairs, ...)

call_site_diff_vs_R0.C1: allowed=set(node.A.A[name]); AS2=address_child(node.A, name, v); prune_state(node.D, AS2.A, ..); _Node(nxt, node.D, AS2, ...)
call_site_diff_vs_R0.R0: allowed=set(node.A[name]); A2=dict(node.A); ...; addresses_fixpoint(A2, node.pairs); prune(node.D, A2, ..)
call_site_diff_vs_R0.additional: node.A.A read, AS2.A read, slot writes
zero in measured runs: guarded by `if self.audit is None: return` exactly as R0
call_site_diff_vs_R0.site: _audit (tests only; audit is None in measured runs)

gate: corrected conservative ratio (scope-matched min O, this N, 1.5x, equal-family) <= 0.80 AND 90/90 adapter rows AND parity (original M2 rows) AND successor audit PASS

rows.order: parent stable_seed order key with stage R_adapter

stage: R_adapter specification, written before the adapter code
